decisions.reason: The accelerator program sits outside the firm's core machinery business and earns little directly, but it costs little to run and still gives the firm options on startup partnerships, so it stays open for now while its value remains unclear.

The bio-based bitumen binder is far from the firm's plastic and oil recycling equipment, needs costly material validation and approval for road construction, and has only a standalone page as evidence of traction, so the firm should release its resources to the many recycling options it already holds.

The infectious waste plant is close to the core business, is promoted on the home page, and is backed by the ERMAFA partnership that shares its cost, so the option is cheap to keep while demand from the medical waste market becomes clearer.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the modular, decentralized strategy, serves both as a pretreatment stage and as a standalone unit, and is featured on the home page as the latest product, so it merits further commitment.
